change.summary: Give all 101 native Tide fish one exact tier and price, preserve exact catch NBT through sale, and add a server-owned Shipping Box bulk transfer.

modifiers.before: Generated per-item values and caps did not represent the approved 101-fish tier contract.
modifiers.after: Exactly 39 Ordinary fish sell for 10 Copper, 25 Rare for 100, 20 Mythic for 500, and 17 Legendary for 10000 before the bounded native-length bonus.
Each exact FishLength receives zero to one percent of its tier base, floored to whole Copper and clamped between the native average and record.
Menu button 4 transfers only accepted player stacks that fit into slots 0 through 53. It does not sell or collect.

cause.owner: JEM Economy item policy and Shipping Box menu

rationale.purpose: Make fish progression predictable and make large Shipping Box deposits safe without weakening exact item identity.
rationale.decision_source: Approved 2026-11-22 one-shot plan and its exact fish appendix
rationale.user_requested: Rework Tide prices, add the native length bonus, and add Deposit All while preserving prior economy work.
rationale.codex_choices: Load one checked manifest during the existing reload and keep all transfer and sale mutations server-owned.

introduced.summary: Apply the exact Tide tier and Shipping Box transfer contract.

history.summary: Add exact native fish sizes, checked whole-Copper pricing, exact NBT consumption, and Deposit All.

relations: Tide native size data -> exact fish manifest -> sale quote
quoted ItemStack NBT -> transaction fingerprint -> consumed ItemStack NBT
player inventory -> Shipping Box policy admission -> input slots
notes: Missing or invalid FishLength uses the native average for price only. Canonical invalid NBT still fails admission.
Deposit All preserves rejected stacks, NBT, capabilities, partial transfers, and leftovers.
unresolved: Player acceptance requires a later explicitly authorized gameplay launch.
